excluded_series.name: redis-no-cpu-clock-p1
excluded_series.reason: Overlapped macOS regression tests; baseline throughput range 10.345228013849294% exceeded the declared 10% stability budget. Excluded in full; replaced with the quiet repeat.

limitations: One virtualized host; not a hardware-PMU or other-platform acceptance study.
Short main-thread-only median passes did not survive 30-second measurements. Baseline p99 variation was also large in some short series.
The main-thread-only prototype drops other threads and off-CPU decoding. Absence of waits in that reduced mode is not evidence of no blocking.
Event-window overlap does not identify kernel causation, client delay, or virtual-machine descheduling.
Probe rate is approximately 100 Hz; PING RTT is not concurrent SET/GET end-to-end latency.
